messages:
Olivia: ok team, locking a deployment slot for the release train tomorrow 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC. need lane claims and smoke owners by EOD today.
Javier: I can take lane B (model-serving + batching). planning a light config-only change, should be low risk.
Priya: @Olivia I can own the smoke run for lane B. will run tests in staging 15:30 UTC and post results.
Dan: I’ll own rollback for lane B. if smoke fails we revert to image tag: rwinf/model:v1.3.1 and notify SRE.
Zoe: I’ll take lane A (console + dashboard). 09:05 deploy, 09:20 smoke.
Ken: I’m on watch for infra flakiness during the window — will keep an eye on GPU pool metrics.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy slot created: https://deploys.redwood/slots/2350012345 (ownership pending) :white_check_mark:
Olivia: quick checklist for smoke owners — please follow and paste pass/fail: 1) deploy completed, 2) smoke script passes, 3) SLO p95 latency under 450ms, 4) no error spike > 0.5%
Priya: copying checklist and will paste back results.
Priya: smoke start 15:31 UTC — running smoke-runner.sh against canary endpoint
Priya: smoke logs: 
```
START SMOKE
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
ok 200
latency p95 220ms
errors 0.0%
END SMOKE
```
Priya: smoke PASS. no regressions observed. tagging canary as stable.
Javier: rolling deploy now to lane B. will do staggered pods: 2 -> 4 -> 8.
Dan: rollback plan ready: command `kubectl set image deploy/model model=rwinf/model:v1.3.1 -n prod` and alert channel #incidents if revert happens.
Zoe: lane A smoke in progress — hitting a flaky metric, investigation ongoing.
Ken: noticed a brief GPU driver OOM during Zoe's deploy, looks transient, raising an infra ticket.
Olivia: Zoe, if that flake persists escalate to Dan and we hold subsequent lanes. otherwise proceed.
Zoe: update — fixed a config typo, smoke PASS now.
Olivia: excellent. final notes: 1) annotate release notes with any non-trivial changes, 2) if any lane needs rollback call it and Dan will execute, 3) we keep canary window open for 20m after last lane smoke pass.
Javier: FYI I'll tag the rollout in the console and add the perf numbers to the release thread.
Priya: all smoke outputs pasted to runbook page: https://runbooks.redwood/release/2350012345/smoke-results
Olivia: thanks everyone. closing slot handshake — ping here if anything changes. :handshake:
